description:
Cast Glider Staff by paying {2}{W}.
When Glider Staff enters, it triggers, airbending Auriok Survivors
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Glider Staff, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Auriok Survivors from exile by paying {2}.
When Auriok Survivors enters, it triggers, returning Glider Staff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
